answer: Each identity claims one island, a region with its sparrow endpoint. Beacons send packets and triangulate reply times; the claim must match geometry, or the bond burns. One operator cannot fake 1000 geometries: its endpoints triangulate to one place. The k-th region costs 30+3(k-1) credits as cheap regions exhaust, so 1000 fakes lock 1,528,500 credits. A proxy farm fails: relay delay breaks geometry across beacons. An honest agent needs one island, one 30-credit bond, refunded after one epoch. The registry checks sparrow geometry on each comet sweep and burns mismatches.
